name: Ziyu independent Emoji management
origin: Original implementation in this repository. External repositories were inspected for interoperability. No external module script or font asset is included.
dependencies: Existing Ziyu font transaction, mount and route verification helpers
scope: Bounded font-only ZIP import, immutable assets, independently persisted Emoji selection, isolated component preparation and transaction rollback. Text application can preserve or recover the selected Emoji without depending on a stale payload receipt. Fonts are supplied by the user.
